automation.detail: Five daily tasks enabled, starting 2026-10-31: improvement ~08:00; correctness ~10:00; security ~12:00; performance ~14:00; dashboard ~16:00, Mexico City time. Only improvement may publish. No completed run is claimed.

deltas.title: Strict input contracts
deltas.value: Reject ambiguous dependencies and fractional counts.

deltas.title: Inspectable JSON CLI
